title: Petition of the Town of Paxton municipal Light Department for authorization and approval for an increase in its depreciation rates from three percent to five percent for the year 1989.

milestones.label: Order
milestones.detail: ORDER ISSUED. Commissioners: McIntyre, Werlin, Tierney (90-11A).

filings: ORDER ISSUED. Commissioners: McIntyre, Werlin, Tierney (90-11A).

The Paxton Municipal Light Department petitions for approval, to continue depreciation rate for calendar year 1989 at 5% cost of utility plant in service. January 1, 1989 less cost of land and land rights.
